scientific_integrity: Proof given for every n>=3 and contrasted with first-public primary source; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the labelled n-gonal antiprism graphs for integer n>=3. Counts P3-convex vertex sets, not symmetry orbits. An independently conducted mathematical audit and comprehensive priority examination are not available; finite verification does not prove the infinite identity.
title: The exact \(P_3\)-convexity polynomial of antiprism graphs
